# Flexireo

> Flexireo makes apparel and footwear non-conformity batches ESPR-audit ready. It scores each blocked batch, coordinates it across every disposition route (rework, reuse, donation, recycling, recovery, disposal), and produces ESPR Article 24 audit-trail documentation as a byproduct.

## Platform

- [Flexireo home](https://flexireo.com)
- [How it works](https://flexireo.com/how-it-works): The seven-stage non-conformity lifecycle, from blocked batch to ESPR-ready documentation.
- [Pricing](https://flexireo.com/pricing): Three tiers — Rework €1,900/month (20,000 reworked units included), ESPR Flow €2,900/month (30,000 ESPR-documented items included), and custom Enterprise pricing. 15% off when paid annually. First project pilot at €950 flat with a full money-back guarantee, credited against your first month if you continue.

## Assess

- [7-minute ESPR Readiness Assessment](https://flexireo.com/espr-compliance/espr-readiness-assessment): See your weakest operational areas before regulators or auditors do.

## Compliance

- [ESPR compliance](https://flexireo.com/espr-compliance): Article 24 disclosure and Article 25 destruction ban for apparel brands; deadlines 19 July 2026 and 2030.
- [What counts as an unsold consumer product](https://flexireo.com/espr-compliance#what-counts-as-an-unsold-consumer-product): Article 2(37) scope; surplus and deadstock, withdrawal-period returns, and the post-consumer exclusion.

## Customer story

- [Sporting goods rework case study](https://flexireo.com/sporting-goods-rework-case-study): Two years inside the rework operation of a multi-country European sporting goods retailer.
